mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ds_secret (id, tenant_id, owner_user_id, secret_kind, cipher_text, key_version, nonce, masked_hint, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{secretKind}, #{cipherText}, #{keyVersion}, #{nonce}, #{maskedHint}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, owner_user_id, secret_kind, cipher_text, key_version, nonce, masked_hint, expires_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM ds_secret WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
